interpretation.late_start_cutoff: Start at or after 22:00 local clock, a descriptive operational window; not a league-approved fairness threshold.
interpretation.late_share_comparison: Team share minus median among teams in its published division with >=5 observed fixtures; same-night baseline also shown.
interpretation.opponent_repeats: Repeated matchups beyond first meeting, within this archived window only. More repeats are not automatically unfair.
interpretation.opponent_elo: Source pregame Elo rating of opponents, available after 2 prior games; context only, not an opponent handicap or cross-night skill calibration.
interpretation.rest: Days between distinct published game dates. Unknown games/other league nights and facility travel excluded.
interpretation.schedule_wholeness: No inference of missing fixtures, open ice, rental permission, full game duration or manager scheduling preferences.
interpretation.decision: No automatic division transfers or schedule changes; commissioner approval and team consultation required.

notices: Source 2026-11-16 capture is not live and may be stale after subsequent results.
Published division labels may reflect realignment after past game dates; do not treat source cross-group matches as rule breaches.
A relative late-start share is not a measure of fatigue, safety, fairness preference or rule violation.
Source holdings may include overlapping match refs, the league authoritative schedule is required before any action.

randomization.model: Shuffle published game start times among games with the same league night, date and separately governed program, preserving team opponents and game dates.
randomization.significance: Two-sided empirical randomization p, BH q 10% exploratory screening and >=30-minute mean-start deviation; not a league fairness test or evidence of an infraction.
inference_limits: Published slot assignments are not necessarily exchangeable: arena ice contract, team preferences, division windows and officials may constrain them.
Randomized schedules are not actual valid fixture alternatives; no rink availability, duration or bookings are modified.
Source 2026-11-16 snapshot is partial. Later schedule additions may materially change results.
Multiple games have simultaneous starts on different rinks; exact game duration and other arena bookings unknown.
A statistical deviation from random allocation is not proof of unfair treatment.
